declarations.name: AuiCheckbox
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Checkbox: `<aui-checkbox>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(checked)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name; clicking it toggles the checkbox.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: indeterminate
inputs.description: Mixed state (aria-checked=mixed via the native property). Cleared when the user toggles.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: The box must be checked; shows the required indicator.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the state invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

models.name: checked
models.description: The checked: `[(checked)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user toggles.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial checked and mixed state and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native <input type="checkbox"> with a <label for> association (HTML; WAI-ARIA APG Checkbox, dual- and tri-state).

limitations: The mixed state is presentational: the user toggling clears it, and it is never submitted.
The box itself is 1.25rem; the 24px minimum target is met by the row and the clickable label, not the box alone.
